text:
anya: quick heads-up0: our premerge SAST ran into decryption failures after the morning KEK rollover. a bunch of PRs show aborted scan runs. cc @oncall-sre

sam: i rotated the key and updated keyring policy at 07:08 UTC. i thought the scanner SA was included but i must've excluded svc-scanner from the new binding by mistake. looking at logs now.

priya: CI error snippets: `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = service account does not have permission to decrypt with key` and the scanner exits before uploading raw bundles. we lose evidence that way.

sec-bot: alert: failed-scan-count increased to 46 in last 15m. automated ticketing may flood triage.

anya: mitigation plan: (1) create a time-limited IAM binding for scanner SA, (2) re-run affected scan matrix, (3) persist raw artifact bundles to artifact-store before decrypt step, (4) tag any resulting vuln tickets with `sdlc:infra-rotation` for filtering.

sam: i'll add an iam binding with a condition to expire in 45m and post the audit log entry id here. command i'm about to run:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key \
  --member=\"serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\" \
  --condition=\"expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-03-23T08:00:00Z'),title=tmp_scanner_decrypt\"
```

sam: posted audit id: A1B2-C3D4-E5F6 (redacted). binding created at 07:12 UTC.

priya: add this to the scan workflow so decrypt failures still upload evidence: 
```
- name: Save scanner output
  run: |
    tar -czf raw-bundle.tgz scanner-output/ || true
    gsutil cp raw-bundle.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/raw-bundle.tgz || true
```

triage-bot: created SEC-5012 \"SAST decrypt failures after KEK rollover\" tags: [sdlc:infra-rotation] assigned @priya

oncall-sre: muting scan noisy alerts for 1h while re-runs happen. will monitor backlog and incident noise.

anya: quick checklist items captured: preflight rotation item: verify scanner SA present in keyring IAM, smoke-run scan against staging after rotation, persist evidence step in workflow. i'll add to the triage playbook and open a short postmortem draft.

priya: follow-ups: sam add the exact iam command and audit id into SEC-5012 (due 10m), sam remove the temp binding after re-runs (due 1h), anya update playbook with rotation checklist (EOD), oncall-sre report back on noisy alert suppression and re-run success (2h).

anya: thanks all  logging root cause candidate as "KEK rotation without re-applying scanner decrypter binding". we'll close the loop after evidence re-runs and short postmortem. :memo:
